activity.overview: Listen to how counting on and counting back work. Then try them.
activity.passage: You can add by counting on. Start with the bigger number in your head. Then count up. For 8 + 3, say 8, then count 9, 10, 11. So 8 + 3 = 11. You can take away by counting back. For 12 - 2, say 12, then count back 11, 10. So 12 - 2 = 10.

questions.prompt: To add 5 + 9, which number should you start with? Tell why.
